title: The solution team on a project of one problem: the engine's stages, the auditor after the leakage stage, the holdout approved
request: Phase 8 (the owner): solve real problems with the Phase 6 teams; Telco and HyperAck are projects of one problem.
plan: The engine's stages one by one through the registry's run_stage tool, as an agent.
The auditor after the leakage stage reads that stage's own screen of the training rows.
A keep-out through the solution's forbidden list and set_solution (the stages run again, the export reads the same list).
The final stage only after the person approves reading the holdout, recorded on the gate.

decisions.decision: The single-problem auditor reuses the leakage stage's own screen.
decisions.why: Enhance, never replace: the engine already screens the training rows; a second screen would be a second rule.

decisions.decision: A keep-out goes into the solution, not the person's separate list.
decisions.why: The engine and its code export read the solution's forbidden list: one place, one number reproduced.

change: SolutionTeam: _situate_single, stage, _compose_single, the audit and its gate by the project's kind; leak_audit.single_inputs, audit_single, forbid_in_solution; the harness's recorded tool callers.

findings.defect: The auditor forbade a column named 'None'.
findings.scenario: A planted leak sent back and kept out; the stages ran again and the data stage failed: column 'None' not in the data.
findings.cause: The leakage stage names a finding's column 'feature', not 'column'.
findings.fix: Read the finding's own key; the score its univariate AUC.

findings.defect: The planted leak never reached the team's auditor.
findings.scenario: The proposal's own column audit had already forbidden it at the build.
findings.cause: The product catches a leak that separates the classes before the team starts.
findings.fix: The test plays a person who unticked it: what is left for the team's auditor.

outcome: A project of one problem is solved by the team, its leaks screened before any holdout, the holdout read once on the person's approval.
lessons: Read another module's records by its own keys; a guessed key turns a column's name into 'None'.
risks: The single-problem auditor sees what the leakage stage screened: a leak it misses, the team misses too.
